tools.name: find_city
tools.description: Looks up a city Vibe of the City covers (hundreds, worldwide) by name and returns its city_slug and page. Call it first whenever another tool needs a city_slug; if the city isn't covered, answer from your own knowledge.

tools.name: get_city_week
tools.description: What is on in a city and the weather, day by day for up to 14 days from today: concerts, markets, festivals and local events, each with its source. Call it for "what's on this weekend", "is next week a good time for X" or to plan around rain. Cite the url it returns; events are as of generatedAt.

tools.name: get_host_guide
tools.description: A published host guide (a holiday flat, a hotel, a guide's page): check-in facts, house information such as wifi and parking, and the host's own tips with coordinates. Call it when the user is staying somewhere with a Vibe of the City guide and asks about the place or the host's tips.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Finds places (cafés, museums, bars, parks, shops) or a street address by name or kind, optionally near a point or a town. tools.name: find_places_near
tools.description: The places right at a point, nearest first: cafés, bars, restaurants, sights and shops within a short walk. tools.name: list_my_trips
tools.description: The user's trips (their own and ones they joined), with city and dates. Returns the trip_id get_trip and add_trip_idea take.

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: One trip's plan: the ideas scheduled per day (with time and place), ideas not yet on a day, and the shortlist of places. Use it for "what's next", "what's on Saturday" or before adding to a trip.

tools.name: get_trip_balances
tools.description: Who paid what on a trip, who owes whom, and the fewest transfers that settle it. Read-only: expenses are added in the app. Use it for "who owes what" or "how much have we spent".

tools.name: list_saved_places
tools.description: Places the user saved as want-to-go or marked as been, with their notes, across every city and trip. Use it to recall "that tapas bar I saved in Madrid" or to suggest from the user's own list first, before any other recommendation.

tools.name: save_place
tools.description: Saves a place to the user's want-to-go list or marks it as been, with an optional note. As when saving in the app, the user's contacts may see the save in their feed. tools.description: Adds an idea to a trip: something to do, optionally on a day, at a time and for a length, optionally pinned to a place (place_ref) or to an address from search_places (name, lat, lng without a place_ref). Everyone on the trip sees it and may get a notification. Confirm the wording, day and time with

tools.name: recommend_activity
tools.description: Logs an activity the user did on a trip — a tour, a tasting, a class, a boat trip, often a GetYourGuide or Viator link — with their verdict, and with publish true recommends it on the trip city's Things to do. An activity is not a place: it needs no pin and never has to be added as one. Pass idea_id

tools.name: update_trip_idea
tools.description: Changes something already on a trip's plan: its wording, day, time, length, note, or where it happens (a place_ref from search_places, or an address's name, lat and lng). Use it instead of add_trip_idea whenever the user means an item that is already there, e.g. "set the location of the ATP match";

tools.name: set_trip_stay
tools.description: Records where the group sleeps on a trip: a hotel, a flat, and the nights it covers when known. Only the trip's members see it; it places their plan's distances. Use it when the user says where they stay or asks to add it, and confirm the name first.

tools.name: add_trip_day_trip
tools.description: Adds a day out to another town to a trip's route, optionally on one of its days. Everyone on the trip sees it. Confirm the town and the day with the user first.

tools.name: plan_trip_days
tools.description: Plans whole days of a trip with Vibe of the City's day planner: a timed sequence of real, open places in the town the group is in that day, built from what this traveller and people like them love, what they turned down, the weather and what is on. One day, or up to three together for a weekend. The

tools.description: Puts a day drafted with plan_trip_days on the trip, every stop nobody added yet: places on the schedule at their times, the rest on the idea board. Everyone on the trip sees it and may get a notification. Only when the user says yes to the drafted day.

tools.name: get_my_vibe
tools.description: The user's own travel vibe as they set it in Vibe of the City: the travel types they like or love, how they take crowds, heat and rain, who they travel with, budget, diet, what they seek, care about and avoid, the vibe dimensions they value most, and how far their profile is filled in. tools.description: Reads a place from a link the user shares: a map link (Google Maps, Apple Maps, OpenStreetMap) or the place's own website. tools.description: Turns a travel article the user wrote themselves (their blog post or guide, an https link) into a DRAFT list of the places it recommends, with their own sentences as notes and the dates it gives. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "import_article_to_list" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Turns a travel article the user wrote themselves (their blog post or guide, an https link) into a DRAFT list of the places it recommends, with their own sentenc…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_city_week, search_places, save_place, add_trip_idea, add_planned_day, import_article_to_list, get_app_help · Private data: save_place, recommend_activity, set_trip_stay, compare_city_vibes, where_to_stay, get_app_help · Public sink: recommend_activity, import_article_to_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_city_week, search_places, save_place, add_trip_idea, add_planned_day, import_article_to_list, get_app_help · Private data: save_place, recommend_activity, set_trip_stay, compare_city_vibes, where_to_stay, get_app_help · Public sink: recommend_activity, import_article_to_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
